chars.design: Retired traveller: exposed small weathered head, long open wool coat, uneven shoulder blanket, tied case and cuff repairs.
Broad iron-capped adult, short riveted scrap vest, bare scarred forearms, hanging side bindings and heavy boots.
Lean shaven adult, slashed one-sleeve coat, diagonal leather sash, wrapped calves and jutting elbow.
Small adult human with a small bald crown, drooped shoulders, long low forearms, torn work smock and bent knees.
Small adult human, side-parted hair, open vest over a narrow chest, bound shins and a one-sided satchel.
Small adult human with loose lank hair, one hanging long sleeve, diagonal chest wrap and long hands.
Small adult leader, high rough collar, overlapping short coat, narrow crown, bandaged forearm. No crown or magical eyes.
Small adult human with knotted hair, sleeveless shoulder wrap, apron-like rag and very narrow feet.
Living emaciated fever patient: lowered small face, long forearms, protruding clothed rib cage, one fallen sleeve, flexed shins.
Living fever patient priest: inclined bald face, worn long vestment and rope stole, bell-shaped hanging censer with chain.
Living infected pilgrim: small side-tilted face, torn long shirt, dry irregular shelf growth on one shoulder and forearm; no glowing aura.
Living infected pilgrim with a different asymmetric back growth, folded hood, sparse crust on calves, worn short surcoat; no mushroom mascot head.
Six-legged service machine, rusted iron shell, brass worm-drive joints, comb cooling fins, dark optical slit and two unequal tool arms.
Same new service machine with legs folded into separate low joints and tool arm resting; four real directional inert poses.
Living failed-treatment fusion: three separate small human heads, four long arms, several joined clothed torsos and dragging legless base; skin and old linen remain distinguishable.
Adult worker: small short-haired head, rolled sleeves, long linen apron, waist cord, knee patch and repair pouch.
Adult caregiver: hair tied under a narrow linen wrap, asymmetric long apron, clean folded cloths at belt and practical side bag; no modern emblem.
Adult guard: open hood, long quilted coat, leather shoulder reinforcement, narrow spear from defined loadout, separate braced legs.
Adult trader: receding narrow head, overlapping long waistcoat, high folded collar, soft document case and belt pockets; no coins or stock count.
Active wanderer: very narrow angular hood, visible small tired face, long legs, diagonal mantle and a separate low satchel. Entirely new geometry.
Low lean feral canine: pointed muzzle, small ears, sloping back, long hock, clumped ash-grey fur and a hanging bent tail.
Larger canine with a separate heavy ruff, wider chest, ragged high withers, shorter hanging tail and neck scar; geometry differs from hound.
Low elongated rodent with distinct snout, folded ear, thin scaly tail, hunched rump and small visible incisors.
Flattened flexible segmented worm, elongated hooked body and end sucker, warm grey skin ridge, no legs, eyes or shell.
Tall chief with split heavy overcoat, layered shoulder slab, scrap helmet, tied hatchet and small worn buckler. Defined loadout visual interpretation.
Lean archer with narrow cowl, sloping quiver, long bow at rest/draw, short side cape and articulated knees. Defined bow loadout.
Active wanderer: very narrow angular hood, visible small tired face, long legs, diagonal mantle and a separate low satchel. Entirely new geometry.
Lean shaven adult, slashed one-sleeve coat, diagonal leather sash, wrapped calves and jutting elbow.
